verdict.rationale: Dots is an always-on agent that reads the user's connected data and returns results and decisions (dots-docs-1, dots-docs-11, dots-docs-12). It proactively flags insights, such as a release decision that conflicts with a draft shared last week (dots-docs-24). It also investigates incoming bug reports and prepares suggested fixes for review (dots-docs-15). missing for 10: dedicated documentation of insight/suggestion generation beyond single examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
